Handles of all loaded objects whose type is in `types`.

Source: R/agent_object_store.R
cv_objects_of_type.Rd

A handle whose value cannot be typed is excluded rather than erroring: this feeds tool-argument auto-resolution, where one unreadable object must not stop the others from being offered.

Usage

cv_objects_of_type(store, types = NULL)

Arguments

store

object store environment.

types

character vector of canonical types (see `cv_object_type()`), or NULL/empty to return every handle.

Value

a character vector of handles, possibly empty.
